scripts.title: CorwenHub | HASE
scripts.author: KashanIsNotMe
scripts.summary: This script is made for Hide and Seek Extreme, Please report any bugs at this email Ryomensukunarush@gmail.com, CorwenHub will continue bringing new open source code scripts
scripts.code:
-- CorwenHub HASE | Hide and Seek Extreme Script
-- Theme: Monochromatic Black & White | Default UI Scale: 0.5x

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- UI Framework Setup
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "CorwenHubUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Toggle Button (Shows when main UI is closed)
local ToggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleButton.Name = "OpenToggle"
ToggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
ToggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.2, 0)
ToggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
ToggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleButton.BorderSizePixel = 1
ToggleButton.Text = "CorwenHub [UI]"
ToggleButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleButton.TextSize = 14
ToggleButton.Visible = false
ToggleButton.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Main Container (Scale set to 0.5 default)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 480)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -190, 0.5, -240)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 10)
MainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 1
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = false
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- Scale constraint for default 0.5x UI sizing
local UIScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
UIScale.Scale = 0.5
UIScale.Parent = MainFrame

-- Title Bar (Draggable Header)
local TitleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TitleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
TitleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
TitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
TitleBar.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TitleBar.BorderSizePixel = 1
TitleBar.Parent = MainFrame

local TitleText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0)
TitleText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
TitleText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleText.Text = "CORWENHUB — HIDE AND SEEK EXTREME"
TitleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TitleText.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
TitleText.TextSize = 14
TitleText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TitleText.Parent = TitleBar

local CloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25)
CloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 5)
CloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
CloseButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseButton.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseButton.BorderSizePixel = 1
CloseButton.Text = "X"
CloseButton.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
CloseButton.TextSize = 14
CloseButton.Parent = TitleBar

-- Scrolling Container for Features
local ContentScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
ContentScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -50)
ContentScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 42)
ContentScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 560)
ContentScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 3
ContentScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ContentScroll.Parent = MainFrame

local UIList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
UIList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
UIList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
UIList.Parent = ContentScroll

-- Dragging Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
TitleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

TitleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + (delta.X / UIScale.Scale), startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + (delta.Y / UIScale.Scale))
    end
end)

CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = false
    ToggleButton.Visible = true
end)

ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    MainFrame.Visible = true
    ToggleButton.Visible = false
end)

-- Helper Functions for Creating Controls
local function CreateButton(text, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 32)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 1
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.Text = text
    btn.Parent = ContentScroll
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return btn
end

local function CreateToggle(text, callback)
    local state = false
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 32)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 1
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    btn.TextSize = 14
    btn.Text = "[ OFF ] " .. text
    btn.Parent = ContentScroll
    
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        btn.Text = (state and "[ ON ] " or "[ OFF ] ") .. text
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40) or Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
        task.spawn(function() callback(state) end)
    end)
    return btn
end

-- Teleport Utility
local function TeleportTo(cframe)
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = cframe
    end
end

-- ========================================================
-- FEATURES IMPLEMENTATION
-- ========================================================

-- 1. Hide Teleport
CreateButton("Hide Location (130, 4, -93)", function()
    TeleportTo(CFrame.new(130, 4, -93))
end)

-- 2. GoTo Map Teleport
CreateButton("GoTo Map Location (74, 60, -118)", function()
    TeleportTo(CFrame.new(74, 60, -118))
end)

-- 3. Hunt Players (Teleports behind all players once with 0 stud gap)
local huntingActive = false
CreateToggle("Hunt Players", function(toggled)
    huntingActive = toggled
    if not toggled then return end
    
    local visited = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if not huntingActive then break end
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and not visited[plr] then
            visited[plr] = true
            local targetHRP = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            -- Position 0 studs directly behind the player's CFrame
            local backPos = targetHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.1)
            TeleportTo(backPos)
            task.wait(0.3)
        end
    end
end)

-- 4. ESP (Player Highlight & Name Labels)
local espEnabled = false
local espContainers = {}

local function ClearESP()
    for _, item in pairs(espContainers) do
        item:Destroy()
    end
    espContainers = {}
end

CreateToggle("ESP Players", function(toggled)
    espEnabled = toggled
    if not espEnabled then ClearESP() end
end)

-- 5. ESP Tracer (Line ESP)
local tracerEnabled = false
local tracers = {}

local function ClearTracers()
    for _, line in pairs(tracers) do
        line:Remove()
    end
    tracers = {}
end

CreateToggle("ESP Tracer", function(toggled)
    tracerEnabled = toggled
    if not tracerEnabled then ClearTracers() end
end)

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    -- ESP Updates
    if espEnabled then
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                if not espContainers[plr.Name .. "_HL"] then
                    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    hl.Name = plr.Name .. "_HL"
                    hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
                    hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
                    hl.Adornee = plr.Character
                    hl.Parent = ScreenGui
                    espContainers[plr.Name .. "_HL"] = hl
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Tracer Updates
    if tracerEnabled then
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local hrp = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local vector, onScreen = Workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                
                if not tracers[plr] then
                    local line = Drawing.new("Line")
                    line.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    line.Thickness = 1.5
                    line.Transparency = 1
                    tracers[plr] = line
                end
                
                local line = tracers[plr]
                if onScreen then
                    line.From = Vector2.new(Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y)
                    line.To = Vector2.new(vector.X, vector.Y)
                    line.Visible = true
                else
                    line.Visible = false
                end
            elseif tracers[plr] then
                tracers[plr].Visible = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Helper for coin detection
local function isCoinItem(inst)
    local name = inst.Name:lower()
    return name:find("token") or name:find("credit") or name:find("coin")
end

-- 6. ESP Coins
local espCoinsActive = false
local coinHighlights = {}

CreateToggle("ESP Coins", function(toggled)
    espCoinsActive = toggled
    if not toggled then
        for _, hl in pairs(coinHighlights) do hl:Destroy() end
        coinHighlights = {}
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1) do
        if espCoinsActive then
            for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") and isCoinItem(obj) and not coinHighlights[obj] then
                    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
                    hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    hl.Adornee = obj
                    hl.Parent = ScreenGui
                    coinHighlights[obj] = hl
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- 7. Auto Collect Coins
local autoCollectActive = false
CreateToggle("Auto Collect Coins", function(toggled)
    autoCollectActive = toggled
    while autoCollectActive do
        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if not autoCollectActive then break end
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and isCoinItem(obj) then
                TeleportTo(obj.CFrame)
                task.wait(0.15)
            end
        end
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)

-- ========================================================
-- 5 EXTRA FEATURES
-- ========================================================

-- 8. WalkSpeed Multiplier
local speedActive = false
CreateToggle("WalkSpeed (28)", function(toggled)
    speedActive = toggled
    task.spawn(function()
        while speedActive do
            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 28
            end
            task.wait(0.2)
        end
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
        end
    end)
end)

-- 9. Infinite Jump
local infJumpActive = false
CreateToggle("Infinite Jump", function(toggled)
    infJumpActive = toggled
end)

game:GetService("UserInputService").JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if infJumpActive and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState("Jumping")
    end
end)

-- 10. Anti-AFK
local antiAfkActive = false
CreateToggle("Anti-AFK Disconnect", function(toggled)
    antiAfkActive = toggled
end)

local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
LocalPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
    if antiAfkActive then
        VirtualUser:CaptureController()
        VirtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.new())
    end
end)

-- 11. Fullbright
local fullbrightActive = false
local oldAmbient = game:GetService("Lighting").Ambient
CreateToggle("Fullbright", function(toggled)
    fullbrightActive = toggled
    if fullbrightActive then
        game:GetService("Lighting").Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness = 2
    else
        game:GetService("Lighting").Ambient = oldAmbient
        game:GetService("Lighting").Brightness = 1
    end
end)

-- 12. Reset Character Shortcut
CreateButton("Instant Re-Spawn / Reset", function()
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.Health = 0
    end
end)

minusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 1, 0)
minusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
minusBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
minusBtn.Text = "-"
minusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
minusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
minusBtn.TextScaled = true
minusBtn.Parent = bottomBar

local plusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
plusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 1, 0)
plusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 0)
plusBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1

plusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
plusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
plusBtn.TextScaled = true
plusBtn.Parent = bottomBar

-- ================= LOGIC =================

camBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    freecamEnabled = not freecamEnabled
    
    if freecamEnabled then
        camBtn.Text = "Freecam: ON"
        camBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 180, 50)
        
        -- Show Teleport and Speed
        tpBtn.Visible = true
        bottomBar.Visible = true
        
        -- Expand top bar to fit both buttons
        topBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 45)
        topBar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0, 25)
        camBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 1, 0)
        
        -- Setup camera
        currentPos = camera.CFrame.Position
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
        pitch = math.asin(look.Y)
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
        
        -- Freeze character
        local char = player.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                originalWalkSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
                originalJumpPower = hum.JumpPower
                hum.WalkSpeed = 0
                hum.JumpPower = 0
            end
        end
    else
        camBtn.Text = "Freecam: OFF"
        camBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 60)
        
        -- Hide Teleport and Speed
        tpBtn.Visible = false
        bottomBar.Visible = false
        
        -- Shrink top bar back to ONE button
        topBar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 45)
        topBar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -70, 0, 25)
        camBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        
        -- Restore camera
        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        if player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            camera.CFrame = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        end
        
        -- Unfreeze character
        local char = player.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed
                hum.JumpPower = originalJumpPower
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- Swipe to rotate (Right side of screen)
UserInputService.TouchMoved:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if freecamEnabled and not gameProcessed then
        if input.Position.X > camera.ViewportSize.X / 2 then
            local sens = 0.005
            yaw = yaw - input.Delta.X * sens
            pitch = math.clamp(pitch - input.Delta.Y * sens, -math.rad(89), math.rad(89))
        end
    end
end)

-- Teleport
tpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if freecamEnabled and player.Character then
        local hrp = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
        end
    end
end)

-- Speed
minusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    speed = math.max(10, speed - 10)
    speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. speed
end)

plusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    speed = math.min(200, speed + 10)
    speedLabel.Text = "Speed: " .. speed
end)

-- Fly with Joystick
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if freecamEnabled then
        local rotCF = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(pitch, 0, 0)
        local mv = Controls:GetMoveVector()
        
        if mv.Magnitude > 0 then
            local moveDir = rotCF:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(mv.X, 0, mv.Z))
            currentPos = currentPos + moveDir * speed * dt
        end
        
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(currentPos) * rotCF
    end
end)

-- TRASH DETECTION
local function isTrashObject(object)
    local current = object

    while current and current ~= workspace do
        local name = current.Name:lower()

        if name:find("bin")
        or name:find("trash")
        or name:find("rubbish")
        or name:find("garbage") then
            return true
        end

        current = current.Parent
    end

    return false
end

local function getObjectPosition(object)
    if object:IsA("Model") then
        return object:GetPivot().Position
    elseif object:IsA("BasePart") then
        return object.Position
    end

    return nil
end

local function getTrashObjects()
    local trash = {}
    local added = {}

    for _, object in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if (object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("BasePart"))
        and isTrashObject(object)
        and not added[object] then

            added[object] = true
            table.insert(trash, object)
        end
    end

    return trash
end

-- DOOR POSITION
local function getDoorCFrame(object)
    if object:IsA("Model") then
        return object:GetPivot()
    end

    return object.CFrame
end

-- CHECK DOOR DISTANCE FROM TRASH
local function isNearTrash(door, trashObjects)
    local doorPosition = getDoorCFrame(door).Position

    for _, bin in ipairs(trashObjects) do
        if bin.Parent then
            local binPosition = getObjectPosition(bin)

            if binPosition and
                (doorPosition - binPosition).Magnitude <= TRASH_RADIUS then
                return true
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

local function getDoors()
    local doors = {}
    local added = {}

    for _, folder in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if folder:IsA("Folder") then
            local folderName = folder.Name:lower()

            if folderName:find("halloween")
            or folderName:find("door") then

                for _, object in ipairs(folder:GetDescendants()) do
                    local name = object.Name:lower()

                    if name:find("door")
                    and (object:IsA("Model") or object:IsA("BasePart"))
                    and not isTrashObject(object)
                    and not added[object] then

                        added[object] = true
                        table.insert(doors, object)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Avoid targeting parts inside a door model separately
    local filtered = {}

    for _, object in ipairs(doors) do
        local insideModel = false

        if object:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _, other in ipairs(doors) do
                if other:IsA("Model") and object:IsDescendantOf(other) then
                    insideModel = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end

        if not insideModel then
            table.insert(filtered, object)
        end
    end

    return filtered
end

local function isHalloweenDoorPrompt(prompt)
    local current = prompt.Parent
    local foundDoor = false
    local foundFolder = false

    while current and current ~= workspace do
        local name = current.Name:lower()

        if name:find("door") then
            foundDoor = true
        end

        if current:IsA("Folder") and
            (name:find("halloween") or name:find("door")) then
            foundFolder = true
        end

        current = current.Parent
    end

    return foundDoor and foundFolder
end

end)

end

-- START
local function start()

    enabled = true
    runId += 1

    local thisRun = runId
    visited = {}

    status.Text = "Status: SEARCHING"
    button.Text = "DISABLE"
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)

    task.spawn(function()
        while enabled and thisRun == runId do
            local doors = getDoors()
            local trashObjects = getTrashObjects()

            if #doors == 0 then
                status.Text = "Status: NO DOORS FOUND"
                task.wait(2)
                continue
            end

            local character = player.Character
            local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            if not humanoid or not root then
                task.wait(1)
                continue
            end

            local available = {}

            for _, door in ipairs(doors) do
                if door.Parent
                and not visited[door]
                and not isNearTrash(door, trashObjects) then
                    table.insert(available, door)
                end
            end

            if #available == 0 then
                local hasSafeDoor = false

                for _, door in ipairs(doors) do
                    if door.Parent and
                        not isNearTrash(door, trashObjects) then
                        hasSafeDoor = true
                        break
                    end
                end

                if hasSafeDoor then
                    visited = {}

                    for _, door in ipairs(doors) do
                        if door.Parent and
                            not isNearTrash(door, trashObjects) then
                            table.insert(available, door)
                        end
                    end
                else
                    status.Text = "STATUS: ALL DOORS NEAR TRASH"
                    task.wait(2)
                    continue
                end
            end

            local nearestDoor
            local nearestDistance = math.huge

            for _, door in ipairs(available) do
                if door.Parent then
                    local distance =
                        (root.Position - getDoorCFrame(door).Position).Magnitude

                    if distance < nearestDistance then
                        nearestDistance = distance
                        nearestDoor = door
                    end
                end
            end

            if nearestDoor then
                status.Text = "STATUS: MOVING TO DOOR"

                local doorCFrame = getDoorCFrame(nearestDoor)

                    end

                task.wait(1)

    [200] = "X", [250] = "Hexagon", [300] = "Diamond", [350] = "Circle",
}
local TOTAL_SHAPES = 8

local function rectKey(img)
    return string.format("%g,%g", img.ImageRectOffset.X, img.ImageRectOffset.Y)
end

local function shapeName(img)
    return SHAPES[img.ImageRectOffset.X] or ("Rect " .. rectKey(img))
end

local function findPaper()
    local bp = lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    local t = (bp and bp:FindFirstChild("LibraryHintPaper"))
        or (lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("LibraryHintPaper"))
    if t then return t end
    local rooms = workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
    return rooms and rooms:FindFirstChild("LibraryHintPaper", true)
end

    local perm = pg:FindFirstChild("PermUI")
    return perm and perm:FindFirstChild("Hints")
end

    local rooms = workspace:FindFirstChild("CurrentRooms")
    local room = rooms and rooms:FindFirstChild("50")
    local assets = room and room:FindFirstChild("Assets")
    if not assets then
        librarySeen = false
        return false
    end
    if assets:FindFirstChild("LiveHintBook", true) then
        librarySeen = true
    end
    return librarySeen

    local s = ui:FindFirstChild(tostring(i))
    if not s then return nil end
    if s:IsA("ImageLabel") or s:IsA("ImageButton") then return s end
    return s:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ImageLabel", true)

local function solve()
    local res = {paper = false, hintCount = 0, slots = {}}

    local byRect = {}
    local hints = findHints()
    if hints then
        for _, c in ipairs(hints:GetChildren()) do
            if c.Name == "Icon" and c:IsA("ImageLabel") then

                end
            end
        end
    end

    local paper = findPaper()
    local ui = paper and paper:FindFirstChild("UI")
    if not ui then return res end
    res.paper = true

    for i = 1, 5 do
        local img = slotImage(ui, i)

    return res

local minimized = false

local function baseHeight()
    return minimized and MINI_H or FULL_H
end

local function setTop(v)
    for i = 1, 5 do digitBoxes[i].Visible = v end
    track.Visible = v
    statusBox.Visible = v
end

local function applyMode()
    if finished then return end
    local m
    if notLibrary then m = "notice" else m = minimized and "mini" or "full" end
    if m == mode then return end
    mode = m

    if m == "notice" then
        tween(win, 0.5, {Size = UDim2.new(0, WIDTH, 0, NOTICE_H)})
        task.delay(0.2, function()
            if closed or mode ~= "notice" then return end
            setTop(false)
            rowsFrame.Visible = false
            noticeScale.Scale = 0
            noticeFrame.Visible = true
            tween(noticeScale, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        end)
    else
        noticeFrame.Visible = false
        setTop(true)
        if m == "full" then
            rowsFrame.Visible = true
            tween(win, 0.45, {Size = UDim2.new(0, WIDTH, 0, FULL_H + sendExtra)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        else
            tween(win, 0.4, {Size = UDim2.new(0, WIDTH, 0, MINI_H + sendExtra)})
            task.delay(0.4, function()
                if mode == "mini" then rowsFrame.Visible = false end
            end)
        end
    end
    if placeSend then placeSend() end
end

    if closed then return end
    closed = true

    tween(winScale, 0.3, {Scale = 0}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.In)

local function fireCode(code)
    local folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RemotesFolder", 3)
    local remote = folder and folder:WaitForChild("PL", 3)
    if not remote then return false, "remote PL not found" end
    local args = {code}
    return pcall(function()
        remote:FireServer(unpack(args))
    end)
end

    task.spawn(function()
        for _, dx in ipairs({-6, 6, -5, 5, -3, 3, 0}) do
            if closed then return end
            tween(obj, 0.04, {Position = base + UDim2.new(0, dx, 0, 0)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine)

        end
        obj.Position = base

    if closed or finished then return end
    if not completeCode then completedCode = nil end
    local want = completeCode ~= nil and mode ~= "notice"

        if not sendShown then showSend() end
        if not sending and lastLabelCode ~= completeCode then
            lastLabelCode = completeCode
            sendLbl.Text = "SEND CODE: " .. completeCode
        end
    elseif sendShown then
        hideSend()

local function applyRow(i, s)
    local r, box = rows[i], digitBoxes[i]
    local dg = s and s.digit
    local state = (not s) and "none" or (dg and "ok" or "bad")

    local txt = dg or (s and "?" or "-")
    if box.Text ~= txt then
        box.Text = txt
        if dg then pop(i, 0) end
    end

    if r.state ~= state then
        r.state = state
        local st = STATE[state]
        tween(box, 0.35, {TextColor3 = st.text, BackgroundColor3 = st.box})
        tween(boxStrokes[i], 0.35, {Color = st.boxStroke})
        tween(r.card, 0.35, {BackgroundColor3 = st.card})
        tween(r.stroke, 0.35, {Color = st.cardStroke, Transparency = st.cardStrokeT})
    end

    local none = state == "none"
    r.empty.Visible = none
    r.nameLbl.Visible = not none
    r.arrow.Visible = not none
    r.valLbl.Visible = not none

    setThumb(r.pThumb, s and s.img)
    r.nameLbl.Text = s and s.name or "-"
    setThumb(r.hThumb, s and s.hint)

    if state == "ok" then
        r.valLbl.Text = dg
        r.valLbl.TextColor3 = C.ok
        r.valLbl.TextSize = 20
    elseif state == "bad" then
        r.valLbl.Text = "no hint"
        r.valLbl.TextColor3 = C.bad
        r.valLbl.TextSize = 13
    else
        r.valLbl.Text = ""
    end
end

local function update()
    if finished then return end
    local d = solve()
    local flashing = flashText and os.clock() < flashUntil

    local function show(text, color, pulsing)
        if flashing then
            setStatus(flashText, flashColor, false)
        else
            setStatus(text, color, pulsing)
        end
    end

    if d.hintCount ~= lastCount then
        lastCount = d.hintCount
        subLbl.Text = string.format("Library  |  hints %d/%d", d.hintCount, TOTAL_SHAPES)
        tween(fill, 0.5, {Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(d.hintCount / TOTAL_SHAPES, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)})
    end

    if inLibrary() or d.paper or d.hintCount > 0 then
        absentSince = nil
        notLibrary = false
    else
        absentSince = absentSince or os.clock()
        if os.clock() - absentSince > 1 then notLibrary = true end
    end
    applyMode()

    if notLibrary then
        for i = 1, 5 do applyRow(i, nil) end
        completeCode, lastCelebrated = nil, nil
        setTheme("warn")
        return
    end

    if not d.paper then
        for i = 1, 5 do applyRow(i, nil) end
        completeCode, lastCelebrated = nil, nil
        setTheme("warn")
        show("Pick up the LibraryHintPaper (backpack or hands)", C.warn, true)
        return
    end

    local digits, missing = {}, {}
    for i = 1, 5 do
        local s = d.slots[i]
        applyRow(i, s)
        digits[i] = (s and s.digit) or "?"
        if not (s and s.digit) then
            missing[#missing + 1] = s and s.name or ("Slot " .. i)
        end
    end

    if #missing == 0 then
        local code = table.concat(digits)
        completeCode = code
        setTheme("ok")
        if completedCode == code then
            show("Puzzle completed!", C.ok, false)
        else
            show("Ready - enter the code from left to right", C.ok, false)
        end
        if code ~= lastCelebrated then
            lastCelebrated = code
            print("[PadlockSolver] code:", code)
            celebrate()
        end
    else
        completeCode, lastCelebrated = nil, nil
        setTheme("idle")
        local shown = {}
        for i = 1, math.min(3, #missing) do shown[i] = missing[i] end
        local txt = "Missing hints: " .. table.concat(shown, ", ")
        if #missing > 3 then txt = txt .. string.format(" +%d more", #missing - 3) end
        show(txt, C.warn, true)
    end
end

        return va:match("(%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x)")

    local function sf(fn, str)
        local up = nil
        if type(getupvalues) == "function" then
            local ok, re = pcall(getupvalues, fn)
            if ok and type(re) == "table" then
                up = re
            end
        end
        if not up and type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.getupvalue) == "function" then
            up = {}
            local i = 1
            while true do
                local ok, na, va = pcall(debug.getupvalue, fn, i)
                if not ok or na == nil then
                    break
                end
                up[na] = va
                i = i + 1
            end
        end
        if not up then
            return nil
        end
        local uu = nil
        local hd = false
        local has = false
        for u, v in pairs(up) do
            if v == s.Damage then
                hd = true
            end
            if not hd and (type(v) == "table" or type(v) == "userdata") then
                local ok, chi = pcall(function()
                    return v.Damage
                end)
                if ok and chi == s.Damage then
                    hd = true
                end
            end
            if (cu and v == cu) or (ch and v == ch) then
                has = true
            end
            local hi = che(v)
            if hi then
                uu = hi
            end
        end
        if hd and uu and (not str or has) then
            return uu
        end
        return nil
    end

            if type(ob) == "function" then
                local hi = sf(ob, true)

                end
            end
        end

s.gwf = function(to, ld)

    for u, pa in ipairs(to:GetDescendants()) do

            if d > bd then

s.cb = function(ep, sp)
    if not sp then
        sp = s.go()
    end
    if not sp then return end
    local fe = s.gb(ep)
    if not fe then return end
    local di = fe - sp
    if di.Magnitude < 0.001 then return end
    local du = di.Unit
    local har = math.abs(du.X) < 0.9 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    local het = du:Cross(har).Unit
    local bl = du:Cross(het).Unit
    local hel = 24
    local htw = 2
    local hr = 0.2
    local function hep(fra, ph)
        local ang = fra * htw * math.pi * 2 + ph
        local r = hr * math.sin(math.pi * fra)
        return sp + di * fra + het * (math.cos(ang) * r) + bl * (math.sin(ang) * r)
    end
    local sa = {}
    local sb = {}
    for sd = 1, 2 do
        sa[sd] = {}
        sb[sd] = {}
        local ph = (sd - 1) * math.pi
        for i = 0, hel do
            local at = Instance.new("Attachment")
            at.WorldPosition = hep(i / hel, ph)
            at.Parent = Workspace.Terrain
            table.insert(sa[sd], at)
        end
        local col = sd == 1 and ColorSequence.new(s.cy, s.ic) or ColorSequence.new(s.az, s.cy)
        for i = 1, hel do
            local be = s.mak(sa[sd][i], sa[sd][i + 1], 1, col, 0.05, "rbxassetid://446111271", 0.6)
            be.LightEmission = 0.9
            table.insert(sb[sd], be)
        end
    end
    local im = s.mb(fe, 0.35, s.db, 0)
    local arb = math.abs(du.X) < 0.9 and Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
    local ac = du:Cross(arb).Unit
    local ae = du:Cross(ac).Unit
    for k = 0, 5 do
        local a = k * math.pi / 3
        local spd = ac * math.cos(a) + ae * math.sin(a)
        local spa = s.mb(fe, 0.12, s.az, 0.2)
        local spe = fe + spd * 1.6 + du * 0.4
        s.ts:Create(spa, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = spe, Transparency = 1 }):Play()
        task.delay(0.3, function()
            pcall(function() spa:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end
    for i = 1, 2 do
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait((i - 1) * 0.07)
            local pu = s.mb(sp, 0.16, s.cy, 0.3)
            s.ts:Create(pu, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Position = fe, Transparency = 0.85 }):Play()
            task.wait(0.24)
            pcall(function() pu:Destroy() end)
        end)
    end
    local de = false
    local function dh()
        if de then
            return
        end
        de = true
        pcall(function() im:Destroy() end)
        for sd = 1, 2 do
            for u, be in ipairs(sb[sd]) do
                pcall(function() be:Destroy() end)
            end
            for u, at in ipairs(sa[sd]) do
                pcall(function() at:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        local rot = 0
        local sta = os.clock()
        local las = sta
        while not de and os.clock() - sta < 2.5 do
            local now = os.clock()
            local dt = now - las
            las = now
            rot = rot + math.pi * 2 * dt / 0.9
            for sd = 1, 2 do
                local ph = (sd - 1) * math.pi
                for i = 0, hel do
                    local at = sa[sd][i + 1]
                    if at and at.Parent then
                        at.WorldPosition = hep(i / hel, ph + rot)
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(2)
        local fd = 0.5
        local fa = 0
        while fa < fd do
            local dt = task.wait()
            fa = fa + dt
            local alp = math.clamp(fa / fd, 0, 1)
            for sd = 1, 2 do
                for u, be in ipairs(sb[sd]) do
                    if be and be.Parent then
                        be.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(alp)
                    end
                end
            end
            if im and im.Parent then
                im.Transparency = alp
            end
        end
        dh()
    end)
    return dh
end
s.fire = function(ta, to, se, uc, hu, mu, ori, hp, zo, no)

        return false
    end
    local ca = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local cam = ca and ca.CFrame or CFrame.new(mu)
    local cp = cam.Position
    if s.hb and s.ft and (hp - cp).Magnitude > 0.1 then
        local oa, aic = pcall(CFrame.lookAt, cp, hp)
        if oa and aic then
            cam = aic
        end
    end
    local sup, fl = s.gbf(to, se)
    pcall(function()
        s.Atirar:FireServer(to, sup, fl, cam, os.clock())
    end)
    local ha = to:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    local cc = nil
    if ha then
        local ab = ha:FindFirstChild("Chamber")
        if ab and (ab:IsA("BasePart") or ab:IsA("Attachment")) then
            cc = ab.WorldCFrame
        elseif ab and ab:IsA("Motor6D") and ab.Part1 and ab.Part1:IsA("BasePart") then
            cc = ab.Part1.CFrame
        else
            cc = ha.CFrame
        end
    end
    if cc then
        pcall(function()
            s.Shell:FireServer(se.BulletType, cc, se.EjectionOverride)
        end)
    end
    local mod = uc and s.cmo or s.bui(se)
    if s.ServerBullet then
        local di = (hp - ori).Unit
        pcall(function()
            s.ServerBullet:FireServer(ori, di, se, mod)
        end)
    end
    local au = (hp - ori).Magnitude
    local fli = s.bul + au / s.bsp(se, mod)
    task.wait(fli)
    if not ta.Character or ta.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") ~= hu then
        return false
    end
    if hu.Health <= 0 then
        return false
    end
    local he = ta.Character and ta.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") or nil
    if he then
        pcall(function()
            s.HitEffect:FireServer(hp, he, no, he.Material, se)
        end)
    end
    local ke = nil
    if s.ck and s.sv and s.cap == s.lp.Character then
        ke = s.ck
    end
    if not ke then
        return false
    end
    local ok = pcall(function()
        s.Damage:InvokeServer(to, hu, au, zo, se, mod, nil, nil, ke, hp)
    end)
    if ok then
        s.bk += 1
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.1)
            local dea = false
            pcall(function()
                dea = hu.Health <= 0
            end)
            if dea and s.kse then
                local now = os.clock()
                local lk = s.kt[ta]
                if not lk or now - lk >= 2 then

                    local mc = s.lp.Character
                    local mr = mc and mc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or nil
                    s.pks(mr and mr.Position or hp)

            end
        end)

end

s.eu = function(fn, cal)
    if type(s.bj) == "function" then
        local ok, up = pcall(s.bj, fn)
        if ok and type(up) == "table" then
            for u, va in pairs(up) do
                cal(va)
            end
            return true
        end
    end
    if type(s.dg) == "function" then
        local i = 1
        while true do
            local res = { pcall(s.dg, fn, i) }
            if not res[1] then
                return false
            end
            if res[2] == nil and res[3] == nil then
                return true
            end
            local va
            if res[3] ~= nil then
                va = res[3]
            elseif type(res[2]) == "string" then
                va = nil
            else
                va = res[2]
            end
            cal(va)
            i = i + 1
        end
    end
    return false
end
s.ff = function(fn, dep)
    local fo = nil
    s.eu(fn, function(va)
        if fo then
            return
        end
        if type(va) == "table" and type(va.Action) == "function" then
            fo = va.Action
        elseif type(va) == "function" and dep < 2 then
            fo = s.ff(va, dep + 1)
        end
    end)
    return fo
end

s.gfa = function()
    local ch = s.lp.Character
    local to = s.ge()
    if ch ~= s.fac or to ~= s.fat then
        s.fir = nil
        s.fac = ch
        s.fat = to
        s.fc = false
    end
    if s.fc then
        if s.fir then
            return s.fir
        end
        if os.clock() < s.fara then
            return nil
        end
        s.fc = false
    end
    s.fc = true
    s.fara = os.clock() + 1
    local bt = s.fb()
    if bt and type(s.dge) == "function" then
        local ok, aq = pcall(s.dge, bt.InputBegan)
        if ok and type(aq) == "table" then
            for u, conn in ipairs(aq) do
                local fn = conn and conn.Function or nil
                if type(fn) == "function" then
                    local ag = s.ff(fn, 0)
                    if ag then
                        s.fir = ag
                        return s.fir
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if type(s.deg) == "function" then
        if s.fas then
            return nil
        end
        local mh = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil
        local ok, obj = pcall(s.deg, true)
        if ok and type(obj) == "table" then
            s.fas = true
            for idx, ob in ipairs(obj) do
                if idx % 200 == 0 then
                    task.wait()
                end
                if type(ob) == "table" and type(ob.Action) == "function" and type(ob.State) == "function" and mh and ob.Humanoid == mh then
                    local oks, br = pcall(ob.State)
                    if oks and type(br) == "table" then
                        s.fir = ob.Action
                        s.fas = false
                        return s.fir
                    end
                end
            end
            s.fas = false
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local lastSentAt = 0
local suggestion = nil
local statusLabel = nil
local hintLabel = nil
local analysing = false

---Require a game module under identity 2 and restore identity 8.
---@param module ModuleScript
---@return any
local function safeRequire(module)
	setthreadidentity(2)
	local ok, result = pcall(require, module)
	setthreadidentity(8)
	return ok and result or nil
end

---Resolve the game's engine, bot and remotes.
local function loadGame()
	local chessFolder = replicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Chess", 10)
	if chessFolder then
		Engine = safeRequire(chessFolder:WaitForChild("Engine"))
		Bot = safeRequire(chessFolder:WaitForChild("Bot"))
	end

	local remotes = replicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ChessRemotes", 10)
	if remotes then
		actionRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("Action")
		updateRemote = remotes:WaitForChild("Update")
	end
end

---Find GameView.current through the GC so joining mid-game still works.
local function findCurrentGetter()
	if not getgc then return end
	for _, fn in ipairs(getgc(false)) do
		if typeof(fn) == "function" and not (isexecutorclosure and isexecutorclosure(fn)) then
			local okName, name = pcall(debug.info, fn, "n")
			local okSrc, source = pcall(debug.info, fn, "s")
			if okName and okSrc and name == "current" and type(source) == "string" and source:find("GameView") then
				currentGetter = fn
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

---Return the newest known game payload.
---@return table?
local function getGame()
	if currentGetter then
		local ok, game = pcall(currentGetter)
		if ok and type(game) == "table" and game.state then
			lastGame = game
		end
	end
	return lastGame
end

---Set the status text in the HUD.
---@param text string
local function setStatus(text)
	if statusLabel then statusLabel.Text = text end
end

---Format a move as coordinate notation.
---@param move table
---@return string
local function formatMove(move)
	return Engine.uci(move)
end

---Search the current position and return the best move.
---@param game table
---@return table?, number?, number?
local function searchBest(game)
	local state = Engine.deserialize(game.state)
	if #Engine.legalMoves(state) == 0 then return nil end

	local score, move, reached = Bot.analyze(state, DEPTH_OPTIONS[depthIndex], TIME_OPTIONS[timeIndex])
	if not move then
		move = Engine.legalMoves(state)[1]
	end
	return move, score, reached
end

---Send a move to the server exactly like the client does.
---@param move table
local function playMove(move)
	if not actionRemote then return end
	actionRemote:FireServer("move", {
		from = move.from,
		to = move.to,
		promo = move.promo,
	})
	lastSentAt = os.clock()
end

---Process the current game once per poll tick.
local function step()
	local game = getGame()
	if not game then
		setStatus("Waiting for a game...")
		return
	end

	if game.over then
		suggestion = nil
		lastKey = nil
		setStatus("Game over")
		if hintLabel then hintLabel.Text = "Best: -" end
		if flags.autoRematch and actionRemote and game.you ~= 0 then
			actionRemote:FireServer("rematch")
		end
		if flags.autoClaim and actionRemote then
			actionRemote:FireServer("claimReward")
		end
		return
	end

	if game.you == 0 then
		setStatus("Spectating")
		return
	end

	local state = Engine.deserialize(game.state)
	if state.turn ~= game.you then
		setStatus("Opponent thinking...")
		return
	end

	local key = tostring(game.id) .. ":" .. tostring(game.ply)
	if key == lastKey then
		-- Server may have rejected the move; retry after a grace period.
		if flags.autoPlay and suggestion and os.clock() - lastSentAt > RETRY_AFTER then
			playMove(suggestion)
		end
		return
	end

	if analysing then return end
	analysing = true
	lastKey = key
	setStatus("Calculating...")

	local move, score, reached = searchBest(game)
	analysing = false
	suggestion = move
	if not move then return end

	local shown = string.format("Best: %s  (%+.2f, d%d)", formatMove(move), (score or 0) / 100, reached or 0)
	if hintLabel then hintLabel.Text = shown end
	setStatus("Your move")

	if flags.autoPlay then
		task.wait(DELAY_OPTIONS[delayIndex])
		local fresh = getGame()
		if fresh and fresh.id == game.id and fresh.ply == game.ply and not fresh.over then
			playMove(move)
		end
	end
end

---Poll loop.
local function pollLoop()
	while running do
		local ok, err = pcall(step)
		if not ok then
			analysing = false
			warn("[ChessDuels] " .. tostring(err))
		end
		task.wait(POLL_INTERVAL)
	end
end

---Return a safe GUI parent.
---@return Instance
local function getGuiParent()
	if gethui then
		local ok, hui = pcall(gethui)
		if ok and hui then return hui end
	end
	return localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

---Build the native GUI.
function ChessDuels.buildGui()
	local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screenGui.Name = "ChessDuels_Menu"
	screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screenGui.Parent = getGuiParent()
	guiRoot = screenGui

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(270, 0)
	frame.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 100)
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 24)
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	frame.Parent = screenGui

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(50, 56, 68)
	stroke.Parent = frame

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = frame

	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10)
	padding.Parent = frame

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = frame

	local order = 0

	local function makeButton(text)
		order += 1
		local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
		button.LayoutOrder = order
		button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)
		button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 38, 44)
		button.BorderSizePixel = 0
		button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
		button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
		button.TextSize = 12
		button.Text = text
		button.Parent = frame

		local btnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		btnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		btnCorner.Parent = button
		return button
	end

	local function makeLabel(text, size)
		order += 1
		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.LayoutOrder = order
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, size or 18)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 170, 185)
		label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		label.TextSize = 11
		label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
		label.Text = text
		label.Parent = frame
		return label
	end

	local function addToggle(text, name)
		local button = makeButton("")
		local function refresh()
			local on = flags[name]
			button.Text = text .. ": " .. (on and "ON" or "OFF")
			button.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(35, 140, 75) or Color3.fromRGB(34, 38, 44)
		end
		button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			flags[name] = not flags[name]
			refresh()
		end)
		refresh()
	end

	local function addCycler(text, options, getIndex, setIndex, suffix)
		local button = makeButton("")
		local function refresh()
			button.Text = text .. ": " .. tostring(options[getIndex()]) .. (suffix or "")
		end
		button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			setIndex(getIndex() % #options + 1)
			refresh()
		end)
		refresh()
	end

	makeLabel("CHESS DUELS (OP) | RightShift").TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

	statusLabel = makeLabel("Waiting for a game...")
	hintLabel = makeLabel("Best: -", 22)
	hintLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 160)
	hintLabel.TextSize = 14

	makeLabel("ENGINE")
	addToggle("Auto-Play Best Move", "autoPlay")
	addCycler("Search Depth", DEPTH_OPTIONS, function() return depthIndex end, function(v) depthIndex = v end)
	addCycler("Think Time", TIME_OPTIONS, function() return timeIndex end, function(v) timeIndex = v end, "s")
	addCycler("Move Delay", DELAY_OPTIONS, function() return delayIndex end, function(v) delayIndex = v end, "s")

	makeButton("Play Best Move Now").MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if suggestion then playMove(suggestion) end
	end)

	makeLabel("MATCH")
	addToggle("Auto Rematch", "autoRematch")
	addToggle("Auto Claim Rewards", "autoClaim")
	makeButton("Resign").MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if actionRemote then actionRemote:FireServer("resign") end
	end)

	makeLabel("UTILITY")
	addToggle("Anti-AFK", "antiAfk")
	makeButton("Detach / Unload").MouseButton1Click:Connect(ChessDuels.detach)

	local dragging, dragStart, startPosition = false, nil, nil

	table.insert(connections, frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then return end
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = frame.Position
	end))

	table.insert(connections, userInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging or input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then return end
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end))

	table.insert(connections, userInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
	end))

	table.insert(connections, userInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			frame.Visible = not frame.Visible
		end
	end))
end

---Clean up everything.
function ChessDuels.detach()
	running = false
	for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
	table.clear(connections)
	if guiRoot then guiRoot:Destroy() guiRoot = nil end
	globalEnv.ChessDuels = nil
	warn("[ChessDuels] Detached.")
end

---Initialize.
function ChessDuels.init()
	loadGame()
	if not (Engine and Bot and actionRemote) then
		error("Chess modules or remotes not found")
	end

	findCurrentGetter()

	-- Capture every game payload the server pushes.
	table.insert(connections, updateRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(payload)
		if type(payload) == "table" and payload.state and payload.you ~= nil then
			lastGame = payload
		end
	end))

	table.insert(connections, localPlayer.Idled:Connect(function()
		if not flags.antiAfk then return end
		virtualUser:CaptureController()
		virtualUser:ClickButton2(Vector2.zero)
	end))

	ChessDuels.buildGui()
	task.spawn(pollLoop)
	warn("[ChessDuels] Loaded. Press RightShift to hide/show GUI.")
end

if globalEnv.ChessDuels then globalEnv.ChessDuels.detach() end
globalEnv.ChessDuels = ChessDuels

---@param err string
local function onInitializeError(err)
	warn("Failed to initialize.")
	warn(err)
	warn(debug.traceback())
	ChessDuels.detach()
end

xpcall(ChessDuels.init, onInitializeError)

            local pos = getModelPosition(model)

            if pos then
                local dist = (hrpPosition - pos).Magnitude

                if dist <= shortestDist then
                    shortestDist = dist
                    nearestModel = model
                end
            end
        else
            CachedModels[model] = nil
        end
    end

    return nearestModel, shortestDist

            local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")

            if hrp and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local targetModel, distance = getNearestModel(hrp.Position)

                            if not IsFarming
                                or not targetModel
                                or not targetModel.Parent
                                or not ScreenGui
                                or not ScreenGui.Parent then

                                CurrentTween:Cancel()
                                CurrentTween = nil
                                break
                            end

                            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                            task.wait(0.01)

                    end
                else
                    ShowAppleNotFound()

                    if CurrentTween then

                    end

        else

                and StatusLabel.Text ~= "Status: Apple not found" then

local function resolveActors(t)

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

local function ProximityPromptCountdown()

end

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- Função para gerar uma cor aleatória com valores mais altos
local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo
while true do
    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end
})


Section3:Button({
   Text = "Aim",
   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end
})

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
local currentTween
local function updateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    local targetPos = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    if currentTween then
        currentTween:Cancel()

    currentTween = TweenService:Create(MainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.05, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = targetPos})

end

end)

            minutes = minutes + 1
        end

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

local function moveToTarget()
    if humanoidRootPart then
        humanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetPosition
    end
end

local cashRegisters = {}

local safes = {}

local function updateCaches()
    for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Model") then
            if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
                table.insert(cashRegisters, child)
            elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
                table.insert(safes, child)
            end
        end
    end
end

updateCaches()

Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
            table.insert(cashRegisters, child)
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
            table.insert(safes, child)
        end
    end
end)

Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
            for i = #cashRegisters, 1, -1 do
                if cashRegisters[i] == child then
                    table.remove(cashRegisters, i)
                end
            end
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
            for i = #safes, 1, -1 do
                if safes[i] == child then
                    table.remove(safes, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
                if openFlag and openFlag.Value then
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                else
                    local openSafe = item:FindFirstChild("OpenSafe")
                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not checkCashRegister() then
        checkSafe()
    end
end)

    while task.wait(0.7) do
        local earned = cashStat.Value - initialCash
        CashLabel.Text = "Earnings: $" .. formatNumber(earned)
    end
end)

    local isOn = false
    local changedEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
    local offColor = button.BackgroundColor3
    local onColor = Color3.fromRGB(46, 204, 113)

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

function Queue.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self
end

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

function Queue:IsEmpty()
    return #self.elements == 0
end
function Queue:Current()
    return self.elements
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

 local key = ''
 local a = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
 for i = 1, optionalSize or 32 do local n = math.random(1, #a) key = key .. a:sub(n, n) end
 return funcs.base64.encode(key)
end

funcs.crypt.encrypt = function(a, b)
 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end
 return table.concat(result)
end

funcs.newcclosure = function(f)
 local a = coroutine.wrap(function(...)
  local b = {coroutine.yield()}
  while true do
   b = {coroutine.yield(f(table.unpack(b)))}
  end
 end)

funcs.isexecutorclosure = function(fnc)
    local found = false
    for i, v in pairs(getgenv()) do
     if v == fnc then return true end
    end
    for i = 1, math.huge do
        local s, env = pcall(getfenv, i)
        if not s or found then break end
        if type(env) == "table" then
            for _, v in pairs(env) do
                if v == fnc then
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if found then break end
    end

    return found
end

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')
 local CurrentPath = {}
 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]
  elseif i == #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
 end
end

 local s, func = pcall(function()
  return loadstring(content)
 end)

end

funcs.listfiles = function(path)
    if not path or path == '' then
     local Files = {}
     for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if #i:split('/') == 1 then table.insert(Files, i) end
     end
     return Files
    end
    if type(files[path]) ~= 'table' then return error(path .. ' is not a folder.') end
    local Files = {}
    for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if startswith(i, path .. '/') and not endswith(i, '/') and i ~= path and #i:split('/') == (#path:split('/') + 1) then table.insert(Files, i) end
    end
    return Files
end
